title: The power of vulnerability | Brené Brown
description: Brené Brown studies human connection -- our ability to empathize, belong, love. In a poignant, funny talk, she shares a deep insight from her research.

transcript.text: So, I'll start with this: a couple years ago, an event planner called me because I was going to do a speaking event.
And she called, and she said, 'I'm really struggling with how to write about you on the little flyer.'

And I thought, 'Well, what's the struggle?' And she said, 'Well, I saw you speak, and I'm going to call you a researcher, I think, but I'm afraid if I call you a researcher, no one will come, because they'll think you're boring and irrelevant.'
And I was like, 'Okay.' And she said, 'But the thing I liked about your talk is you're a storyteller. So I think what I'll do is just call you a storyteller.'

title: Simon Sinek: The Number One Reason Why You're Not Succeeding
description: Simon Sinek discusses the infinite game, leadership, and why the current corporate structure is fundamentally flawed.

transcript.text: The problem with the way we do business today is that it's largely finite.
We're obsessed with winning, we're obsessed with beating the competition, we're obsessed with being number one.
The problem is, business is an infinite game.
There's no such thing as 'winning' business. There's no such thing as being 'number one' in business.
Because the game doesn't end. And when you play with a finite mindset in an infinite game, you get some very predictable outcomes.
